posts.preview: As a member of the ILO, Namibia has adopted a tripartite system involving Government, employers, and workers. However, meaningful tripartite engagement remains largely at the national level, with limited involvement of employers and trade unions in regional development discussions
Workers continue to suffer in silence, with some facing victimization for joining or participating in trade unions, including public servants.

We must strengthen tripartite structures at the regional level and ensure that labour and industrial relations become a shared responsibility. Every worker deserves a voice, protection, and decent work#servewithpassion
